title: Innovations in AI: Brain-inspired design for more capable and sustainable technology
description: Researchers and their collaborators are drawing inspiration from the brain to develop more sustainable AI models. Projects like CircuitNet and CPG-PE improve performance and energy efficiency by mimicking the brain's neural patterns.
